availability.module.name: Availability
availability.module.description: Members say when they are free, maybe or busy, with a weekly pattern and dated exceptions. People who plan for a team see it in one place, and can ask the team to check theirs.
availability.settings.grid.step.label: Time step
availability.settings.grid.step.help: The smallest piece of time people mark on their availability. Times start and end on this step.
availability.settings.entry.unmarked-def: What a person's unmarked time means, unless they choose for themselves. "Not known" asks planners to check; "Free" assumes they can come.
availability.settings.entry.horizon.help: The furthest ahead anyone can enter a dated change to their availability.
availability.abilities.find.anyone.label: See anyone's availability
availability.abilities.request.send.labe: Ask people to check their availability
availability.navigation.mine.label: My availability
availability.settings.grid.day-starts.he: The first time shown on the availability grid before scrolling.
availability.settings.grid.day-ends.help: The last time shown on the availability grid before scrolling.
availability.grid.label: Your availability, a row for each time and a column for each day
availability.grid.now-the-end: Now choose where it ends, on the same day.
availability.mine.title: My availability
availability.mine.description: Show when you are free, maybe or busy, so people planning rehearsals and meetings can find a time that suits you.
availability.mine.how: Choose Free, Maybe, Busy or Clear, then drag down a day, or click a single time. On a phone, tap where it starts and then where it ends. Tap a day's name to paint all of it. Clear takes back what you painted.
availability.mine.asked-help: Mark the times you cannot do, then press "This is right". Press it even if nothing has changed.
availability.mine.asked-done: You have said this is right. You can still change your availability.
availability.mine.entries-help: Changes for particular dates, newest winning where they overlap. They come before your weekly pattern.
availability.mine.which-title: Just these days, or every week?
availability.mine.which-help: This day follows your "{pattern}" pattern. Change just this day, or the pattern for every week it covers? We will remember your answer while you are on this page.
availability.entry.title: Add a change
availability.entry.description: For particular dates: away, exams, or free after all.
availability.entry.dates-needed: Choose the first and last day.
availability.entry.some-days: Only on some days of the week
availability.entry.until-after: The end must be after the start.
availability.entry.reason-help: Only you see it, unless you share it below.
availability.entry.share: Share the reason with people who plan for me
availability.entry.share-help: Only people planning for a group you are in, such as your production's team, will see it.
availability.patterns.title: Weekly patterns
availability.patterns.description: Your usual week, such as your timetable this term. Changes for particular dates come first; your pattern fills in the rest.
availability.patterns.new-help: Give it a name and the dates it covers, then paint its week.
availability.patterns.none-help: Add your usual week once, and planners see it every week it covers.
availability.patterns.remove-help: Its times stop showing on every week it covered. Your changes for particular dates stay.
availability.patterns.label: Name
availability.patterns.label-help: Only you see it, such as "Spring term".
availability.patterns.ends-help: Leave empty to keep it going.
availability.patterns.ends-after: The last day must be on or after the first.
availability.patterns.edit-help: Paint a typical week. It applies to every week between the dates.
availability.patterns.how: Drag down a day, or click a single time. On a phone, tap where it starts and then where it ends.
availability.patterns.not-found: There is no such pattern of yours
availability.settings.requests.default-d: How long people have to answer when a new request is sent. The person sending it can change the date.
availability.settings.requests.first-rem: How long before the answer date people who have not answered are reminded. 0 sends no first reminder.
availability.settings.requests.second-re: How long before the answer date people who still have not answered are reminded again. 0 sends no second reminder.
availability.navigation.requests.label: Availability requests
availability.asked.title: Asked of me
availability.asked.description: Requests to check your availability. Mark the times you cannot do, then press "This is right", even if nothing changed.
availability.asked.none-help: When someone who plans for one of your groups asks the group to check their availability, it shows here.
availability.asked.how: Paint the times you cannot do. Changes save as you go; press "This is right" when the period is right.
availability.asked.closed-help: This request has closed, so no more reminders will come. You can still change your availability and answer.
availability.sent.title: Requests I have sent
availability.sent.description: Ask a group to check their availability, and see who has answered.
availability.sent.new-help: Everyone in the groups is asked and told by email. People who join a group while the request is open are asked too.
availability.sent.none-help: Ask a group you plan for to check their availability for a period, such as a term of rehearsals.
availability.sent.no-groups-help: You can ask a group once you plan for it, for example as a production's director or stage manager.
availability.sent.title-help: What it is for, such as "Spring term rehearsals". People see it in the email.
availability.sent.groups-help: Everyone in these groups is asked.
availability.sent.due-help: Reminders go before this date to anyone who has not answered.
availability.sent.message-help: Shown to everyone asked. Do not name anyone in it.
availability.sent.last-reminded: Last reminded by hand {when}. You can remind once a day.
availability.sent.close-help: Reminders stop. People can still change their availability and answer late.
availability.sent.withdraw-help: They are no longer asked or reminded. Their availability is not changed.
availability.abilities.entry.on-behalf.l: Mark people they plan for as away
availability.settings.retention.past.hel: How long a dated change is kept once it is over. Shortening it deletes older changes at the next nightly tidy-up.
Keep closed requests and polls for
How long a closed request or a finished poll, and who answered it, is kept. Shortening it deletes older ones at the next nightly tidy-up.
availability.behalf.title: Mark {name} as away
availability.behalf.description: For something they told you, such as a phone call. They are told, and can change or remove it.
availability.behalf.added: What you have added for them
availability.behalf.reason-help: Seen by them and by you. Other planners see only that they are away. Keep it short and factual.
availability.privacy.title: Who can see my availability
availability.privacy.description: Your availability is seen only by people who plan for a group you are in.
availability.privacy.groups-help: The people who plan for each group can see your availability while you are in it.
availability.privacy.no-groups: You are not in any groups yet
availability.privacy.no-groups-help: When you join a production's team or another group, it shows here with who plans for it.
availability.privacy.see-levels: Whether you are free, maybe or busy at each time, and times you have not marked.
availability.privacy.see-reasons: A reason only where you ticked "Share the reason" on that change.
availability.privacy.see-updated: When you last changed your availability, and the date you last checked it to.
availability.privacy.never-patterns: The names of your weekly patterns.
availability.privacy.never-calendar: Anything about the events in a calendar you connect: only busy times are kept.
availability.privacy.never-others: Nobody outside your groups sees your availability, apart from the few people the theatre lets see everyone's for planning.
availability.navigation.find.label: Find a time
availability.abilities.find.use.label: Find a time for groups they plan for
availability.find.title: Find a time
availability.find.description: See when the people in your groups are free, and the best times to meet or rehearse.
availability.find.dates-help: Up to about two months at once.
availability.find.dates-needed: Choose the dates to look at.
availability.find.room-optional-help: Still suggest times when the rooms are taken.
availability.find.start-help: Choose groups and dates, then find times. Nothing is sent to anyone.
availability.find.hidden: {count} people are left out because you do not plan for them.
availability.find.best-help: Ranked by most people free, then fewest maybes. Everyone marked as must come is free in each. Confirmed commitments elsewhere count as busy, pencilled ones as maybe.
availability.find.no-best: No time works for everyone who must come
availability.find.no-best-help: Try more dates, wider hours, a shorter length, or fewer people who must come.
availability.find.who-help: Everyone at their least available over this time.
availability.find.grid-caption: How many people are free at each time
availability.find.key: Each cell shows how many are free, greener the more are. Struck through: someone who must come cannot. Striped: a chosen room is taken.
availability.find.people-help: Tick the people a time must suit. Best times then leave out any time one of them cannot do.
availability.settings.polls.abandon-afte: How long after its answer date a poll nobody has decided is given up. Everyone asked, and the person who sent it, is told.
availability.poll.title: Poll
availability.poll.answer-needed: Choose an answer for this time.
availability.poll.private: Say which times you can make. Only the person who sent the poll sees your answers, and answering does not change your availability.
availability.poll.times-help: How many people answered yes, if need be, or no for each time.
availability.poll.closed-help: This poll is no longer taking answers.
availability.poll.people-help: Each person's answer for each time. Only you see these.
availability.poll.decide-help: The poll closes and everyone asked is told the time.
availability.poll.abandon-help: The poll closes without a time and everyone asked is told.
availability.poll.title-help: What the time is for, as the people asked will see it.
availability.poll.answers-by-help: Answers close at the end of this day. You can choose a time whenever you like.
availability.poll.send-help: The people in your chosen groups are asked which of these times they can make.
availability.poll.asked-answered: Answered. You can change your answers until {due}.
availability.meeting.title: Meeting
availability.meeting.notes-help: Everyone invited sees this. Do not name anyone in it.
availability.meeting.title-help: What the meeting is, as the people invited will see it.
availability.meeting.tell-help: A new time always tells everyone and asks them to answer again.
availability.meeting.arrange-help: Everyone in the groups you chose is invited and asked whether they are going.
availability.meeting.arrange-poll-help: Everyone the poll asked is invited and asked whether they are going.
availability.meeting.change-help: A new time tells everyone and asks them to answer again.
availability.meeting.cancel-help: Everyone invited is told it is cancelled.
